miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: is designed to teach the 18xx game system, and comes with three levels of play. Level 1 deals purely with building railroad network and operating trains. Level 2 introduces the financial element, with the addition of the stock market, and introduces the separation of the player and the railroad as separate entities. Level 3 introduces three different types of companies (privates, minors and a merger company) that players may control.
